_comment: Generative parameters for the simulation pipeline of the companion manuscript (Methods 4.1/4.5): synthetic contact matrices with exponential distance decay, planted TAD enrichment, and multiplicative Gamma noise, calibrated to the statistical signatures of the Rao et al. (GSE63525) K562 chromosome-1 contact map (distance-decay slope, intra-/inter-TAD enrichment, per-bin coverage), with planted TAD sizes drawn from the same dataset's empirical distribution. All seeds are fixed for full reproducibility.

sensitivity._note: noise_sigma is the residual standard deviation in absolute units of the centered expression, applied when regenerating the response during the noise-sensitivity run.
